name: The Dawning Archaic
description: The most powerful and dangerous archaic, formed from the soul of the last-ever oracle and suffering paradoxical fluxes from temporal instability.

description_citations.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
description_citations.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: The Dawning Archaic, formed from the soul of the last oracle, is sundered from mana and time by an unknown phenomenon.
timeline.quote: The Dawning Archaic was formed from the soul of what will be the last-ever oracle on the plane.
